<h2>ABCD Study Data Documentation</h2>

Welcome to the data documentation website of the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development℠ (ABCD) Study. Here you will find detailed information about the ABCD data resource, including how to access and use the data responsibly, documentation for released instruments and variables, and tools for exploring and analyzing the data.
:::
